name: Court Will
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Mercer Island, Washington
side_practice_areas: Criminal Defense, DUI-DWI, White Collar Crimes
about: As a partner at Will and Will, Attorneys At Law, Court Will is a devoted attorney who is committed to serving his clients in the Seattle, Washington, area. He focuses his practice exclusively on criminal defense. Mr. Will accepts a range of cases, including DUI, drug possession and distribution, theft, sex offenses, domestic violence and violent crimes.

A Washington native, Mr. Will received a Bachelor of Arts in sociology from Pepperdine University in 2000 and then went on to be awarded his Juris Doctor at Pepperdine University School of Law in 2003. While in law school, he completed internships with the Federal Bureau of Investigation and the Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office. After graduation, Mr. Will initially worked as a criminal defense attorney in California before returning to his home state.

Recognized by his fellow attorneys for his excellent track record and high degree of ethics, Mr. Will has received a 10.0 "Superb" peer-review rating through Avvo. He is admitted to practice in Washington, California and the District of Columbia. His practice is dedicated to criminal defense, and he was the first attorney in the country to take a sex offender case to trial. Mr. Will's work received additional recognition when he was involved in Dateline NBC's reality television show "To Catch a Predator" in 2007.

In order to keep abreast of current developments in criminal law, Mr. Will is an active participant in several organizations. His memberships include the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the California Public Defenders Association, the Washington Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the National Institute for Trial Advocacy.
